consumer: An engine LOS-gated check (e.g. ranged-fire/throw/interaction eligibility) asking 'does the avatar have an unobstructed line of sight to tile T right now?' — it EVALUATES a yes/no it computes from map::sees.
scope: point-to-point line of sight from the avatar's position to the one target tile within sight range (not a map region, not memory/seen state).
decisive_source: src/map.cpp::map::sees — its body tests current reachability/visibility from F to T within range via the four-argument overload, returning the engine's own LOS boolean.
divergence: A wall is built between the avatar and the target tile that the avatar has previously seen: map::pl_sees (Excerpt 2) still reports the tile as seen=true (remembered), but map::sees correctly returns false because live line of sight is now blocked — using the seen proxy yields a wrong 'has LOS' answer.
